ticket.subject: Production database connection keeps dropping
ticket.description: Our production environment is losing its database connection every 2-3 hours and requires a manual restart to recover. This is causing serious downtime. We are on the Enterprise plan and this started 3 days ago.

ticket.subject: Annual plan renewal failed — card was charged but no confirmation
ticket.description: My annual renewal was processed and I can see the charge of $1188 on my credit card statement but I have not received a confirmation email and my account shows expiring tomorrow. Please confirm the renewal went through.

ticket.subject: Password reset emails not arriving
ticket.description: I requested a password reset three times over the past hour and have not received any email. I have checked my spam folder. Other emails from your domain arrive fine. This is blocking me from accessing my account.

ticket.subject: Request: Export tickets to PDF format
ticket.description: Currently we can only export tickets to CSV. It would be very helpful to also support PDF export with our company branding for sharing with non-technical stakeholders and for audit purposes.

ticket.subject: Incorrect tax calculation on EU invoices
ticket.description: Our invoices for EU customers are not applying the correct VAT rate. UK customers should have 20% VAT and German customers should have 19% but all EU invoices are showing 0% VAT. This started after your billing system update last Tuesday.

ticket.subject: Notification emails showing raw HTML instead of formatted content
ticket.description: All notification emails I receive now show raw HTML tags instead of formatted text. For example I see p Hello Fiona /p instead of the formatted greeting. This makes the emails unreadable and looks unprofessional to our clients.

ticket.subject: Android app does not support fingerprint authentication
ticket.description: The iOS app supports Face ID login but the Android app only has username and password. Our security policy requires biometric authentication for all mobile access. Can fingerprint or face unlock be added to the Android app?
